details: The United States and Iran recently exchanged strikes, with the U.S. bombing Iranian radar and drone sites in response to an American drone being shot down over the weekend (May 30-31). Iran retaliated with its own strikes and, according to Iran's Tasnim news agency, has halted indirect negotiations with the U.S. and plans to block the Strait of Hormuz. This escalation, alongside Israel's expanded offensive in Lebanon, caused oil prices to jump by approximately $5 a barrel, raising concerns about global energy supplies and inflation.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate, Oil Prices Jump Amid Strait of Hormuz Blockade Fears

details: The European Union's Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation (MiCA) transitional period concludes on July 1, 2026. By this critical deadline, all crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) operating within the EU must obtain a MiCA license or cease regulated operations. This comprehensive regulatory framework introduces uniform rules across member states, including stringent stablecoin reserve requirements and increased transaction visibility for tax authorities, which is expected to lead to market consolidation.
title: EU MiCA Crypto Regulation Deadline Nears, Firms Must Acquire Licenses by July 1
